syncs.description: Make accessible Read.ai meeting reports available as records containing meeting metadata and available enriched report content. Active reports may lack enrichment; workspace Downloads and report-access permissions apply.
syncs.name: sync-meetings

functions.name: get-live-meeting
functions.description: Get currently available live data for an ongoing, live-enabled meeting, optionally filtering live content by its start time. This does not enable live capture.

include.description: Live content to request; defaults to both available live expansions. An empty array requests metadata only.

meetingId.description: Opaque Read.ai meeting ULID from list-meetings.

startedAfter.description: Exclusive start-time bound for live content, not the meeting itself; requires explicit UTC or offset and millisecond precision or coarser.

startedAtOrAfter.description: Inclusive start-time bound for live content, not the meeting itself; requires explicit UTC or offset and millisecond precision or coarser.

FunctionInput_read_ai_getlivemeeting.description: Select a live meeting snapshot, its live content expansions, and optional content start-time bounds.

endAt.description: Actual meeting end in UTC if supplied; null for absent or null end_time_ms.

folders.description: Folder names or labels exactly as supplied.

startAt.description: Actual meeting start in UTC with millisecond precision.

platform.description: Originating platform label, without restricting unknown labels.

reportUrl.description: Web URL of the meeting report.

platformId.description: Opaque meeting identifier on the originating platform.

transcript.description: Currently available expanded live transcript; omitted if absent, preserving explicit null.

text.description: Provider-supplied transcript text, including any speaker labels.

turns.description: Available live transcript turns in provider order; no completeness or finality guarantee.

endAt.description: Turn end instant normalized to UTC, preserving milliseconds.

speaker.description: Speaker attributed to this live transcript turn.

name.description: Speaker display name; not a stable speaker identity.

startAt.description: Turn start instant normalized to UTC, preserving milliseconds.

speakers.description: Speaker list in provider order; repeated names are preserved.

name.description: Speaker display name; not a stable speaker identity.

liveEnabled.description: Provider real-time capture flag; does not by itself ensure live data exists.

scheduledEndAt.description: Scheduled end instant in UTC, when supplied.

chapterSummaries.description: Currently available expanded chapter summaries in the provider-defined JSON structure; omitted if absent.

scheduledStartAt.description: Scheduled start instant in UTC, when supplied.

FunctionOutput_read_ai_getlivemeeting.description: Currently available live meeting metadata and expanded content, without a completeness or finality guarantee.

tags.instructions: Find the meeting ID and liveEnabled status using `list-meetings`. Use this for ongoing meetings; use `get-meeting` for completed reports. By default, someone must have the live meeting dashboard open for data to be available; automatic capture requires Read.ai support. This returns the currently available snapshot without waiting for more content. The optional time bound filters live data rather than selecting meetings.

meetingId.description: Read.ai meeting ULID obtained from list-meetings; treated as an opaque identifier.

include.description: Additional report content to request. Omitted or empty means metadata only; more expansions may increase latency.

tags.instructions: Use this for a known meeting ID from `list-meetings`. Select include fields when you need report content beyond metadata. Use `get-live-meeting` instead for ongoing live-enabled meeting data. Active meetings can lack enrichment because it is generated after the meeting ends. Recording download expansion returns download information, not recording bytes.

functions.name: list-meetings
functions.description: List one page of accessible active and ended meetings, newest first, optionally filtering their start times and including enriched report content.

limit.description: Maximum meetings in this page; defaults to 10.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from the previous page; reuse with the same connection, filters, and include choices.

include.description: Additional report fields to request; omitted or empty requests base meeting metadata only. More fields can increase response time.

startedAfter.description: Exclusive lower bound on meeting start time, with an explicit UTC marker or offset and millisecond precision or coarser.

startedBefore.description: Exclusive upper bound on meeting start time, with an explicit UTC marker or offset and millisecond precision or coarser.

startedAtOrAfter.description: Inclusive lower bound on meeting start time, with an explicit UTC marker or offset and millisecond precision or coarser.

startedAtOrBefore.description: Inclusive upper bound on meeting start time, with an explicit UTC marker or offset and millisecond precision or coarser.

FunctionInput_read_ai_listmeetings.description: One page of meetings with optional start-time bounds and report expansions.

endAt.description: Actual meeting end in UTC; null means active because upstream end_time_ms is absent or null.

tags.instructions: Use this to discover meeting IDs and browse reports. Use `get-meeting` for a known meeting and `get-live-meeting` for ongoing live content. Each call returns at most 10 meetings. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same filters and expansions to continue. Active meetings may not yet have enriched report content. Access is limited to reports available to the connected user; workspace Downloads must be enabled.
